1. Casing: The outer shell of the pump, which is typically made of steel or cast iron.
2. Impeller: The rotating component of the pump that draws in the fluid and pushes it out through the diffuser. It is usually made of cast iron or bronze.
3. Diffuser: The component that directs the fluid flow into the discharge piping. It is typically made of bronze or cast iron.
4. Motor: The power source for the pump, which can be either an electric motor or a diesel engine.
5. Seal System: A system used to prevent leakage of the fluid around the impeller. It typically consists of mechanical seals and an oil lubrication system.
6. Product Lubricated: The lubricant used in this type of pump is typically a type of oil that is used to lubricate the moving parts of the pump. The oil is pumped along with the fluid being pumped, and helps to reduce wear and tear on the pump components.
